scope: Process-only separate long-running owned fixed-size Wayland diagnostic; unchanged default/fixed/resize behavior without the exact new token
planned_stop: Controller must establish >=600 seconds and owned-child liveness before SIGINT, then bounded reap; source does not install or change signal handlers
notes: The original upstream renderer/presenter is preserved. Owned mode skips wl_seat binding and validates the exact compositor PID and UID1000 over SO_PEERCRED before registry binding.
The original fixed2400..3600 and resize2200..2400 argument ranges and90-second alarms are unchanged; only the exact soak token permits1000000frames with660-second alarm.
Early normal loop exit refuses. Planned SIGINT retains the existing process signal behavior; it is not graceful Vulkan teardown or explicit presentation-retirement proof.
Actual image count is checked after swapchain creation; the minImageCount request is not a driver allocation cap. All original extent, image-count, configuration and recreation bounds remain.
Soak-only texture-image API failures reuse bounded metadata reporting and exit2; fixed diagnostics keep their original prefix/output, default and resize behavior remain unchanged.
Host helper tests do not exercise real Wayland/GPU, Android, memory workload, physical performance or any device.

terminal_soak_validator.scope: Explicit512MiB acceptance only; matching workload receipt required. Actual historical768MiB evidence remains valid. No reduction in duration, disk, liveness, planned-stop, filtering or cleanup checks.

build_scope: Offline ARM64 ELF compilation and metadata only; no executable/Wayland/GPU/device runtime test or controller launch
